modes.name: trunk_forward
modes.plus: Trunk shifts forward over the planted tips.
modes.minus: Trunk shifts backward over the planted tips.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_left
modes.plus: Trunk shifts left over the planted tips.
modes.minus: Trunk shifts right over the planted tips.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along roll

modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.plus: Trunk lowers while all four tips remain planted.
modes.minus: Trunk rises while all four tips remain planted.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: trunk_roll_left
modes.plus: Trunk rolls about positive x, raising its left side.
modes.minus: Trunk rolls about negative x, raising its right side.

modes.name: trunk_pitch_forward
modes.plus: Trunk pitches about positive y, lowering its front.
modes.minus: Trunk pitches about negative y, raising its front.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along pitch

modes.name: trunk_yaw_left
modes.plus: Trunk turns left about positive z over the planted tips.
modes.minus: Trunk turns right about negative z over the planted tips.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along yaw

modes.name: fl_tip_forward
modes.plus: Freed front-left tip moves forward and upward.
modes.minus: Freed front-left tip moves backward and upward.

modes.name: fl_tip_left
modes.plus: Freed front-left tip moves left and upward.
modes.minus: Freed front-left tip moves right and upward.

modes.name: fl_tip_up
modes.plus: Freed front-left tip folds upward toward its limb root.
modes.minus: Front-left tip remains at its home joint configuration.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: fr_tip_forward
modes.plus: Freed front-right tip moves forward and upward.
modes.minus: Freed front-right tip moves backward and upward.

modes.name: fr_tip_left
modes.plus: Freed front-right tip moves left and upward.
modes.minus: Freed front-right tip moves right and upward.

modes.name: fr_tip_up
modes.plus: Freed front-right tip folds upward toward its limb root.
modes.minus: Front-right tip remains at its home joint configuration.

modes.plus: Freed rear-left tip moves forward and upward.
modes.minus: Freed rear-left tip moves backward and upward.

modes.name: rl_tip_left
modes.plus: Freed rear-left tip moves left and upward.
modes.minus: Freed rear-left tip moves right and upward.

modes.name: rl_tip_up
modes.plus: Freed rear-left tip folds upward toward its limb root.
modes.minus: Rear-left tip remains at its home joint configuration.

modes.name: rr_tip_forward
modes.plus: Freed rear-right tip moves forward and upward.
modes.minus: Freed rear-right tip moves backward and upward.
